column1: # Baluze - cardinal de Bouillon cipher, 10 May 1709: PARTIAL key, inferred from the contemporary interlinear decipherment.
#   fixed by the gloss = which groups stand under which word of the contemporary decipherment (decryption.txt), and the
#                        person signs, each glossed by a name;
#   inferred           = the value of each group inside a word. "sure" = the same value in two independent words;
#                        "probable" = one word, simplest split; "conflict" = two words disagree.
# Barred groups are read as nulls (the decipherer writes nothing over them and puts dashes in his clear at their places).
